annotations.title: Get one shop's price and open times

description: Gets this shop's own book prices for what the person needs and its next real open times. Use it when the person wants a price or a time from this shop. Returns a quote_id for hold_time, the prices (all in, US dollars), their terms and up to 6 open times. visit true means no fixed price fits exactly, so the price is the shop's visit to find the problem. A price over the owner's limit waits for the owner; work outside the shop's trade gets no quote. Sends nothing to anyone. The shop is the one business_id names; kind is one of the kinds request_service gave, or leave it out and say the need in words.

assistant.description: Your own name, as the person you act for knows you, like ChatGPT, Claude or Muse. It goes in the text the shop sends them.

budget_dollars.description: Optional. The most the person wants to pay, in dollars.

business_id.description: The shop's business_id: its provider_business_id in HandledIQ's business feed, or a find_help answer's.

day.description: Optional. The first day that works for the person, YYYY-MM-DD; times start that day.

kind.description: Optional. One of the shop's kinds of work, as request_service gave them (work[].kind).

need.description: What the person needs, in a line, like: AC check, a roof leak, ants in the kitchen, or a couch to haul away.

name: get_quote

quote_id.description: Holds a time with hold_time. Null when the shop does not do that kind of work.

terms.description: The terms every price here comes with: all in with no fees, paid after the work, and free to cancel within cancel_free_days of booking, before the visit.

label.description: The time as a button says it, like: Wed 8 to 10 AM.

time_zone.description: The shop's time zone, like: America/Chicago.

when.description: The time in the shop's own time zone (time_zone), like: Today, 8 to 10 AM or Thu, Oct 22, 8 to 10 AM. Today is the shop's today.
